# Reaction Time

## Remove outliers

```{r}
# 1. Remove inaccurate participants (< 75% mean accuracy)
inacc.parts <- d %>% 
  group_by(Experiment, ID.true, Task, Category) %>% 
  summarise(MeanAccuracy = mean(Accuracy), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(MeanAccuracy < .75)

d.inaccurate.removed <- d %>% 
  anti_join(inacc.parts, by = "ID.true")

# 2. Filter for accurate trials only
d.inaccurate.removed <- d.inaccurate.removed %>% 
  filter(Accuracy == 1)

# 3. Trim reaction time outliers beyond 3x IQR range
cutoff.high <- quantile(d.inaccurate.removed$LogReactionTime, na.rm = TRUE)[4] + 
               (IQR(d.inaccurate.removed$LogReactionTime, na.rm = TRUE) * 3)

cutoff.low <- quantile(d.inaccurate.removed$LogReactionTime, na.rm = TRUE)[2] - 
              (IQR(d.inaccurate.removed$LogReactionTime, na.rm = TRUE) * 3)

df.outliers.removed <- subset(
  d.inaccurate.removed, 
  (LogReactionTime > cutoff.low) & (LogReactionTime < cutoff.high)
)

# Distribution plots
hist(df.outliers.removed$LogReactionTime, breaks = 100, col = "lightblue", 
     xlab = "LogReactionTime (ms)", main = "Histogram after Outlier Removal")

```


```{r}
agr <- df.outliers.removed %>% 
  group_by(Experiment,Task) %>% 
    summarize(MeanReactionTime = mean(ReactionTime), 
              CILow = ci.low(ReactionTime), 
              CIHigh = ci.high(ReactionTime)) %>%
    mutate(YMin = MeanReactionTime - CILow, 
           YMax = MeanReactionTime + CIHigh)
nrow(agr)
print(agr)
# write.csv(agr,"../data/categorization_agg.csv")
```

```{r}
agr_summary <- df.outliers.removed %>% 
  group_by(Experiment, Task) %>%

    MeanRT = mean(ReactionTime),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(agr_summary, caption = "Summary Statistics by Experiment and Task") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

# Total RT with median and mode stats

## horizontal format
```{r}
agr <- df.outliers.removed %>%
    group_by(Experiment,Task,Word) %>%
    summarize(MeanReactionTime = mean(ReactionTime), 
              CILow = ci.low(ReactionTime), 
              CIHigh = ci.high(ReactionTime)) %>%
    mutate(YMin = MeanReactionTime - CILow, 
           YMax = MeanReactionTime + CIHigh)

agr$Task <- ifelse(agr$Task == "Valence", "Valence", "TruthCond")
agr$Task <- factor(agr$Task, levels = c("TruthCond","Valence"))

# Set dodge width to match violin grouping
dodge_width <- 0.9

ggplot(agr, aes(x = Experiment, y = MeanReactionTime, fill = Task)) + 
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +

  # Add mean point with matching dodge
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               shape = 23,
               size = 2,
               position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  stat_summary(fun = median,
                geom = "crossbar",
                width = 0.3, 
                linewidth = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  labs(y = "Mean Reaction Time", x = "Experiment") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    axis.title.x=element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),     # x-axis title
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),     # y-axis ticks
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),     # x-axis ticks
  )



ggsave("../graphs/total_rt_paper2.jpg",width = 8, height = 4)
ggsave("../graphs/exp1_paper.pdf",width = 8, height = 4)
```



## vertical format
```{r}
agr <- df.outliers.removed %>%
    group_by(Experiment,Task,Word) %>%
    summarize(MeanReactionTime = mean(ReactionTime), 
              CILow = ci.low(ReactionTime), 
              CIHigh = ci.high(ReactionTime)) %>%
    mutate(YMin = MeanReactionTime - CILow, 
           YMax = MeanReactionTime + CIHigh)

agr$Task <- ifelse(agr$Task == "Valence", "Valence", "TruthCond")
agr$Task <- factor(agr$Task, levels = c("TruthCond","Valence"))

# Set dodge width to match violin grouping
dodge_width <- 0.9

ggplot(agr, aes(x = Experiment, y = MeanReactionTime, fill = Task)) + 
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +

  # Add mean point with matching dodge
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               shape = 23,
               size = 2,
               position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  stat_summary(fun = median,
                geom = "crossbar",
                width = 0.3, 
                linewidth = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  labs(y = "Mean Reaction Time", x = "Experiment") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10), limits=rev) +
  # scale_x_discrete() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),     # x-axis title
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),     # x-axis ticks
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),     # y-axis ticks
    axis.title.y=element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```
